Bug_Details: Access to a private protocol buffer field is forbidden. This protocol buffer carries a security contract, and can only be created using an approved library. Direct access to the fields is forbidden.
Bug_Explanation: The bug is demonstrated by attempting to directly access a private field of a SecurityContract object. In a real-world scenario, this would be a forbidden operation due to the security restrictions of the protocol buffer.
Trigger_Explanation: The bug is triggered by calling the showBug method, which attempts to access a private field of a SecurityContract object.
Bug_Trigger_Explanation: The test method executed successfully without any assertion errors, indicating that the attempt to access a private field of a security contract object did not cause any immediate issues during the test run.
